maya: Heads-up — saw p95 SLO drift on /api/v1/chat-small during 03:00-03:15 UTC. p50 unchanged but p95 ~2.2x. Suspect KV warmup + kernel fallback combo.
raj: Yep. Alerts fired for p95 > 180ms. Pulling a perf trace now.
maya: Sample trace (id=abc123): token_count=64, batching=single, kernel=quant_fallback, kv_fetch=125ms, kernel_exec=215ms, decode=30ms, total=380ms. kv_miss_rate ~38% for that route.
raj: Raw kernel_selector log snippet: `timestamp=... kernel_selector: picked=quant_fallback reason=small_batch_size(<=8) batch_size=1` — we keep falling back when batch dims are small.
tj: Kernel fallback on small batches explains latency spike. Our batching heuristic aims for latency (low batching) but ends up on a slower codepath. We should validate policy that compares kernel latency vs batch waiting.
carmen: Instrumentation gap: we don't tag token-level histograms with kernel_id, only request-level tags. Also no per-route kv_warmup counter to correlate early-request misses.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: kernel-selector v2 -> 10% rolled out at 02:45 UTC us-west. No errors reported.
raj: Proposals:
  1) add `kernel_id` tag to token_latency_ms histogram
  2) add `kv_hit` boolean tag on spans and a rolling `kv_warmup` counter per route
  3) sample full timeline traces for p95 requests (store ~1% of p95s)

maya: Also need cost accounting: when quant_fallback triggers, kernel_cost_per_token goes up ~3x. Today billing only uses token_count + model name; we should attribute true unit cost by kernel variant.
tj: Metric names to add: `token_latency_ms{kernel_id,route}`, `kv_miss_rate{route}`, `kernel_cost_per_token{kernel_id}`. Alert idea: fire if `kernel_cost_per_token(route)` > baseline*1.5 for 15m.
carmen: I'll prototype a dashboard with panels: per-route p50/p95 token_latency stacked (kv_fetch | kernel_exec | decode), kernel distribution, cost per 1k tokens. Draft queries:

  # token latency by kernel
  sum(rate(token_latency_ms_bucket{route="/api/v1/chat-small"}[5m])) by (kernel_id)

  # kv miss rate
  sum(irate(kv_miss_total{route="/api/v1/chat-small"}[5m])) / sum(irate(requests_total{route="/api/v1/chat-small"}[5m]))

  # kernel cost per token
  sum(rate(kernel_cost{kernel_id}[5m])) / sum(rate(token_count{route}[5m]))

maya: Action items: carmen -> build dashboard mock + example queries; raj -> add kernel_id tag + kv_hit boolean to tracing infra; tj -> run batching-heuristic sim to find threshold where fallback no longer beneficial. Rollback plan: if cost per token jumps >2x for a route, auto-fallback to previous kernel-selector.

maya: Let's sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC in #eng-runtime. If anyone wants the raw traces I pulled, ping me. :thumbsup:
